G1831.def:
**ἐξέρχομαι**,
[in LXX chiefly and very frequently for יצא, also for עלה ,בּוֹא, etc. ;] depon.,
**to go, or come out of**: [[Mat.10.11|Mat.10:11]], [[Mrk.1.35|Mrk.1:35]], [[Jhn.13.30|Jhn.13:30]], al.; with inf., [[Mat.11.8|Mat.11:8]], [[Mrk.3.21|Mrk.3:21]], [[Luk.7.25, 26|Luk.7:25, 26]] [[Act.20.8|Act.20:8]]; id. before ἐπί, [[Mat.26.55|Mat.26:55]], al.; εἰς, [[Mrk.1.38|Mrk.1:38]] ἵνα, [[Rev.6.2|Rev.6:2]] ἐ. before ἐκ (cl. with genitive loc.), [[Mrk.5.2|Mrk.5:2]], [[Jhn.4.30|Jhn.4:30]], al.; ἔξω, with genitive, [[Mat.21.17|Mat.21:17]], [[Mrk.14.68|Mrk.14:68]], [[Act.16.13|Act.16:13]], [[Heb.13.13|Heb.13:13]]; ἀπό, [[Mrk.11.12|Mrk.11:12]], [[Luk.9.5|Luk.9:5]], [[Php.4.15|Php.4:15]]; ἐκεῖθεν, [[Mat.15.21|Mat.15:21]], [[Mrk.6.1|Mrk.6:1]], [[Luk.9.4|Luk.9:4]], al.; of demons expelled, before ἐκ (ἀπό), with genitive of person(s), [[Mrk.1.25, 26; 5.8|Mrk.1:25, 26 5:8]], [[Luk.4.35|Luk.4:35]], al.; of prisoners released, [[Mat.5.26|Mat.5:26]], [[Act.16.40|Act.16:40]]; ptcp., ἐξελθών, with indic., of verb of departure (cf. Dalman, _Words_, 20f.), [[Mat.8.32; 15.21; 24.1|Mat.8:32 15:21 24:1]], [[Mrk.16.8|Mrk.16:8]], [[Luk.22.39|Luk.22:39]], [[Act.12.9, 17|Act.12:9, 17]] al. Metaphorical,
(a) **of persons**: [[2Co.6.17|2Co.6:17]], [[1Jn.2.19|1Jn.2:19]]; of birth or origin, [[Mat.2.6|Mat.2:6]] (LXX), [[Heb.7.5|Heb.7:5]] (cf . [[Gen.35.11|Gen.35:11]]); of escape from danger, ἐκ τ. χειρὸς αὐτῶν, [[Jhn.10.39|Jhn.10:39]] of public appearance, [[1Jn.4.1|1Jn.4:1]]
(b) **of things**: [[Mat.24.27|Mat.24:27]] esp. of utterances, **reports, proclamations**: φωνή, [[Rev.16.17; 19.5|Rev.16:17 19:5]]; φήμη, [[Mat.9.26|Mat.9:26]], [[Luk.4.14|Luk.4:14]]; ἀκοή, [[Mrk.1.28|Mrk.1:28]] λόγος, [[Jhn.21.23|Jhn.21:23]] δόγμα, [[Luk.2.1|Luk.2:1]] (cf. δι-εξέρχομαι).
(AS)

G1833.def:
**ἐξ-ετάζω**
(ἐτάζω (rare), to examine), [in LXX: [[Deu.13.14-15|Deu.13:14-15]] [[Deu.19.18|Deu.19:18]], [[1Ch.28.9|1Ch.28:9]] A (דָּרַשׁ), דָּרַשׁ), [[Psa.11.5-6|Psa.11:5-6]] (בָּחַן), [[Wis.6.3|Wis.6:3]], [[Sir.3.21|Sir.3:21]], al. ;]
**to examine closely, inquire carefully **(of ): before περί (with ἀκριβῶς), [[Mat.2.8|Mat.2:8]] before τίς, [[Mat.10.11|Mat.10:11]] with accusative of person(s), [[Jhn.21.12|Jhn.21:12]]†
_SYN._: ἀνακρίνω, ἐραυνάω (see _DCG_, ii, 594b) (AS)

G1875.def:
**ἐπ-άν **
_conj._ (ἐπεί, which see, ἄν)
later form of ἐπήν,
**after, when**: with subjc. Pres., [[Luk.11.34|Luk.11:34]] with subjc. aor., [[Mat.2.8|Mat.2:8]], [[Luk.11.22|Luk.11:22]].†
(AS)

G1843.def:
**ἐξ-ομολογέω**, -ῶ and depon. mid., -έομαι, -οῦμαι
[as always in LXX chiefly for יָדָה hi. ;]
1. act. = cl. ὁμολογέω, **to profess or agree to do **(Field, _Notes_, 75): [[Luk.22.6|Luk.22:6]]
2. Mid., **to acknowledge, confess **(MM, _Exp._, xiv): τ. ἁμαρτίας, [[Mat.3.6|Mat.3:6]], [[Mrk.1.5|Mrk.1:5]], [[Jas.5.16|Jas.5:16]]; τ. πράξεις, [[Act.19.18|Act.19:18]] before ὅτι, [[Php.2.11|Php.2:11]] with dative of person(s), **to make acknowledgment to one's honour, to praise, give praise to **(as in LXX; Kennedy, _Sources_, 118): [[Rom.14.11|Rom.14:11]](LXX) [[Rom.15.9|Rom.15:9]] (LXX); before ὅτι, [[Mat.11.25|Mat.11:25]], [[Luk.10.21|Luk.10:21]] (Cremer, 771).†
(AS)

G1807.def:
**ἐξ-αιρέω -ῶ **
[in LXX chiefly for נָצַל hi. ;]
**to take out**: with accusative, ὀφθαλμόν, [[Mat.5.29; 18.9|Mat.5:29 18:9]]; mid.
(a) **to take out for oneself, choose**: [[Act.26.17|Act.26:17]] (Thayer, see word; Page, Ac., l.with, but see infr.);
(b) **to deliver**: [[Act.7.10, 34|Act.7:10, 34]]" (LXX) [[Act.12.11|Act.12:11]] [[Act.23.27|Act.23:27]] [[Act.26.17|Act.26:17]] (EV, but see supr.), [[Gal.1.4|Gal.1:4]]†
(AS)

G1849.def:
**ἐξουσία**, -ας, ἡ
(ἔξεστι), [in LXX: [[4Ki.20.13|4Ki.20:13]], Psa.113 (114):2 135 (136)8, 9, [[Isa.39.2|Isa.39:2]], Jer.28 (51):28 (מֶמְשָׁלָה), frequently in Da for Aram. שָׁלְטָן, etc., [[Wis.10.14|Wis.10:14]], [[Sir.9.13|Sir.9:13]], al. ;]
1. prop., **liberty** or **power to act**, freedom to exercise the inward force or faculty expressed by δύναμις (which see): [[1Co.9.12|1Co.9:12]] ἐ. ἔχειν, [[2Th.3.9|2Th.3:9]] id. before inf., [[Jhn.10.18|Jhn.10:18]], [[1Co.9.4|1Co.9:4]], 5; with genitive obj., [[Rom.9.21|Rom.9:21]] before ἐπί, with accusative, [[Rev.22.14|Rev.22:14]] περί, [[1Co.7.37|1Co.7:37]]
2. Later (cf. Milligan, _Th._, 114; MM, _Exp._, xiv), of the power of **right, authority**: [[Mat.21.33|Mat.21:33]], [[Mrk.11.28|Mrk.11:28]], [[Luk.20.2|Luk.20:2]]; of Messianic authority, [[Mat.9.6|Mat.9:6]], [[Mrk.2.10|Mrk.2:10]], al.; of apostolic authority, [[2Co.10.8; 13.10|2Co.10:8 13:10]]; of the authority of government: [[Mat.8.9; 28.18|Mat.8:9 28:18]], [[Jude.25|Ju 25]], [[Rev.12.10|Rev.12:10]], al.; esp. of judicial authority, [[Luk.20.20|Luk.20:20]], [[Jhn.19.10, 11|Jhn.19:10, 11]].
3. Meton.,
(a) **jurisdiction**: [[Luk.23.7|Luk.23:7]] (cf. [[1Ma.6.11|1Ma.6:11]], [[Isa.39.2|Isa.39:2]]);
(b) **a ruler** or **magistrate**: [[Rom.13.1-3;|Rom.13:1-3]] pl., [[Luk.12.11|Luk.12:11]], [[Rom.13.1|Rom.13:1]], [[Tit.3.1|Tit.3:1]];
(with) **of supramundane powers **(syn. with ἀρχή, δύναμις, θρόνος, κυριότης): [[1Co.15.24|1Co.15:24]], [[Eph.1.21; 3.10|Eph.1:21 3:10]], [[Col.2.10|Col.2:10]], [[1Pe.3.22|1Pe.3:22]], al. (Cremer. 236).
_SYN._: see: δύναμις. (AS)

G1857.def:
**ἐξώτερος**, -α, -ον
(compar., from ἔξω; opposite to ἐσώτερος) [in LXX chiefly for חִיצוֹן ;]
**outer**: σκότος, [[Mat.8.12|Mat.8:12]] [[Mat.22.13|Mat.22:13]] [[Mat.25.30|Mat.25:30]].†
(AS)

G1881.def:
**ἐπ-αν-ίστημι **
[in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;]
**to raise up against**; mid., **to rise up against**: before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.10.21|Mat.10:21]], [[Mrk.13.12|Mrk.13:12]].†
(AS)

G1839.def:
**ἐξ-ίστημι** (also in Hellenistic -ιστάνω, [[Act.8.9|Act 8:9]]),
[in LXX for H2730, etc. (29 words in all) ;],
1. causal in Pres., impf., fut., 1 aor., to put out of its place; metaphorically, ἐ. τινά φρενῶν (Eur.), to drive one out of his senses, hence, absol., **to confound, amaze**: with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.24.22|Luk.24:22]], [[Act.8.9, 11|Act.8:9, 11]].
2. _Intr._ in pass. and mid., also in 2 aor., pf., plpf. act., before ἐκ or with genitive, to stand aside from, retire from; esp. τ. φρενῶν, to lose one's senses (Eur.), hence, absol.;
(a) **to be beside oneself, be mad**: [[Mrk.3.21|Mrk.3:21]], [[2Co.5.13|2Co.5:13]] (opposite to σωφρονεῖν);
(b) **to be amazed, confounded**: [[Mat.12.23|Mat.12:23]], [[Mrk.2.12|Mrk.2:12]] [[Mrk.5.42|Mrk.5:42]] [[Mrk.6.51|Mrk.6:51]], [[Luk.2.47|Luk.2:47]] [[Luk.8.56|Luk.8:56]], [[Act.2.7, 12|Act.2:7, 12]] [[Act.8.13|Act.8:13]] [[Act.9.21|Act.9:21]] [[Act.10.45|Act.10:45]] [[Act.12.16|Act.12:16]] (Cremer, 309).†
(AS)

G1816.def:
**ἐξ-ανα-τέλλω **
[in LXX: [[Gen.2.9|Gen.2:9]], [[Psa.104.14|Psa.104:14]] [[Psa.132.17|Psa.132:17]] [[Psa.147.8|Psa.147:8]] (צָמַח hi.); [[Psa.112.4|Psa.112:4]] (זָרַח) * ;]
1. trans., to cause to spring up (LXX).
2. Intrans. (as ἀνατέλλω, [[Gen.3.18|Gen.3:18]]), **to spring up**: [[Mat.13.5|Mat.13:5]], [[Mrk.4.5|Mrk.4:5]].†
(AS)

G1877.def:
**ἐπ-αν-άγω **
[in LXX: [[Zec.4.12|Zec.4:12]] (רוּק hi.), [[Sir.17.26; 26.28|Sir.17:26 26:28]], [[2Ma.9.21|2Ma.9:21]] [[2Mac.12.4|2Mac 12:4]] * ;]
**to bring up or back **(sc. ναῦς); to put out to sea (_DB_, iii, 63b): [[Luk.5.3-4;|Luk.5:3-4]] intrans., **to return**: [[Mat.21.18|Mat.21:18]]†
(AS)

G1855.def:
**ἔξωθεν **
_adv._ (ἔξω opposite to ἔσωθεν), [in LXX for חוּץ ;]
1. prop. (in answer to the question, Whence ?), **from without**: [[Mrk.7.18|Mrk.7:18]]
2. More often (= ἔξω; cf. Bl., § 25, 3), **without**: [[Mat.23.27-28|Mat.23:27-28]] [[Mrk.7.18|Mrk.7:18]], [[2Co.7.5|2Co.7:5]]; τὸ ἔ., [[Mat.23.25|Mat.23:25]], [[Luk.11.39-40|Luk.11:39-40]]; οἱ ἔ., [[1Ti.3.7|1Ti.3:7]], [[Mrk.4.11|Mrk.4:11]] (WH, mg.); ὁ ἔ. κόσμος, [[1Pe.3.3|1Pe.3:3]] ἐκβάλλειν ἔ., [[Rev.11.2|Rev.11:2]] As prep. with genitive: [[Mrk.7.15|Mrk.7:15]], [[Rev.11.1-19|Rev.11:1-19]] [[2Ki.14.20|4Ki.14:20]] (cf. Robertson, _Gr._, 548).†
(AS)

G1859.def:
**ἑορτή**, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX for חַג (chiefly), מוֹעֵד ;]
**a feast, festival**: [[Luk.2.42|Luk.2:42]], [[Jhn.5.1|Jhn.5:1]], [[Jhn.6.4|Jhn.6:4]] [[Jhn.7.37|Jhn.7:37]], [[Col.2.10|Col.2:10]]; ἡ ἑ. τοῦ πάσχα, [[Luk.2.41|Luk.2:41]], [[Jhn.13.1|Jhn.13:1]]; τ. ἀζύμων, [[Luk.22.1|Luk.22:1]] ἡ σκηνοπηγία, [[Jhn.7.2|Jhn.7:2]] (Deiss., _LAE_, 116); ἐν τ. ἑ., [[Mat.26.5|Mat.26:5]], [[Mrk.14.2|Mrk.14:2]], [[Jhn.4.45; 7.11; 12.20|Jhn.4:45 7:11 12:20]] (εἶναι ἐν ἑ.), [[Jhn.2.23|Jhn.2:23]] εἰς τ. ἑ. (for the feast), [[Jhn.13.29|Jhn.13:29]] ἀναβαίνειν, ἔρχεσθαι εἰς τ. ἑ., [[Jhn.4.45; 7.8-10; 11.56; 12.12|Jhn.4:45 7:8-10 11:56 12:12]]; τῆς ἐ μεσούσης, [[Jhn.7.14|Jhn.7:14]] κατὰ ἑ. (at each feast), [[Mat.27.15|Mat.27:15]], [[Mrk.15.6|Mrk.15:6]], [[Luk.23.17|Luk.23:17]], R, mg.; τ. ἑ. ποιεῖν, [[Act.18.21|Act.18:21]] κατὰ τὸ ἔθος τῆς ἑ., [[Luk.2.42|Luk.2:42]]†
(AS)

G1844.def:
**ἐξ-ορκίζω**
(later form of ἐξορκόω ), [in LXX: [[Jdg.17.2|Jdg.17:2]] (אָלָה), [[Gen.24.3|Gen.24:3]], [[1Ki.22.16|3Ki.22:16]] (שָׁבַע hi.)* ;]
1. to administer an oath to (Dem., Polyb., al.).
2. **to adjure**: with accusative of person(s), before κατά, with genitive (as frequently in magic π.; MM, _Exp._, xiv), [[Mat.26.63|Mat.26:63]]†
(AS)

G1887.def:
**ἐπ-αύριον**,
_ adv._ [in LXX for מָחָר, [[Gen.30.33|Gen.30:33]], elsewhere, [[Exo.9.6|Exo.9:6]], al., for מׇחֳרָת ;]
**on the morrow**: in NT, ἡ ἐ. (sc. ἡμέρα), [[Mat.27.62|Mat.27:62]], [[Mrk.11.12|Mrk.11:12]], [[Jhn.1.29|Jhn.1:29]], [[Act.10.9|Act.10:9]], al
(AS)

G1846.def:
**ἐξ-ορύσσω **
[in LXX: [[Pro.29.22|Pro.29:22]] ὀφθαλμόν (-ούς), [[Jdg.16.21|Jdg.16:21]], [[1Sa.11.2|1Ki.11:2]] (נָקַר)* ;]
**to dig out, dig up**: στέγην, [[Mrk.2.4|Mrk.2:4]] metaphorically, ὀφοαλμούς (cf. LXX, ll with; Herod., viii, 116), [[Gal.4.15|Gal.4:15]]†
(AS)

G1824.def:
**ἐξ-αυτῆς**
(a κοινή word, = ἐξ αὐτῆς τ. ὥρας)
**at once, forthwith**: [[Mrk.6.25|Mrk.6:25]], [[Act.10.33|Act.10:33]] [[Act.11.11|Act.11:11]] [[Act.21.32|Act.21:32]] [[Act.23.30|Act.23:30]], [[Php.2.23|Php.2:23]].†
(AS)

G1870.def:
**ἐπ-αισχύνομαι **
[in LXX: [[Job.34.19|Job.34:19]] (נָשָׂא), [[Psa.119.6|Psa.119:6]] (בּוּשׁ), [[Isa.1.29|Isa.1:29]] A (חָפֵר) * ;]
**to be ashamed **(of): absol., [[2Ti.1.12|2Ti.1:12]] with accusative of person(s), [[Mrk.8.38|Mrk.8:38]], [[Luk.9.26|Luk.9:26]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[Rom.1.16|Rom.1:16]], [[2Ti.1.8; 1.16|2Ti.1:8 1:16]]; ἐπί, with dative of thing(s), [[Rom.6.21|Rom.6:21]] with inf., [[Heb.2.11|Heb.2:11]] with, accusative of person(s), and inf., [[Heb.11.16|Heb.11:16]],†
(AS)

G1819.def:
**ἐξάπινα** = ἐξαπίνης, ἐξαίφνης (which see),
[in LXX for פִּתְאוֹם, etc. ;]
**suddenly**: [[Mrk.9.8|Mrk.9:8]]†
(AS)

G1847.def:
**ἐξ-ουδενέω**
(Rec. -όω; T, -θανόω), -ῶ, [in LXX (with vv. ll. -όω, -θενέω, -θενόω) for בּוּז, בָּזָה, מָאַס, בּוּס, etc. ;]
**to despise, set at nought**: [[Mrk.9.12|Mrk.9:12]] (cf. ἐξουθενέω).†
(AS)

G1817.def:
**ἐξ-ανίσημι **
[in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;]
1. trans., **to raise up**: σπέρμα (cf. [[Gen.38.8|Gen.38:8]]), [[Mrk.12.19|Mrk.12:19]], [[Luk.20.28|Luk.20:28]].
2. In 2 aor. act., intrans., **to rise**: [[Act.15.5|Act.15:5]]†
(AS)

G1810.def:
**ἐξ-αίφνης** (WH, ἐξέφνης, exc. [[Act.22.6|Act.22:6]] see _App._, p. 151, and cf. M, _Pr._, 35), adv.
(ἄφνω), [in LXX chiefly for פִּתְאוֹם ;]
suddenly [[Mrk.13.36|Mrk.13:36]], [[Luk.2.13; 9.39|Luk.2:13 9:39]], [[Act.9.3; 22.6|Act.9:3 22:6]].†
(AS)

G1895.def:
**ἐπει-δή-περ **
conj.,
**forasmuch as **("a stately compound," frequently in cl. and suitable for the formal introduction of Lk): [[Luk.1.1|Luk.1:1]]†
(AS)

G1896.def:
**ἐπ-εῖδον ** 2 aor. without Pres. in use;
[in LXX chiefly for רָאָה ;] to regard with attention, look upon (in cl., of the gods)
1. **with a view to bless**: with inf., [[Luk.1.25|Luk.1:25]] (cf. _DB_, 136b).
2. **To punish**: before ἐπί, [[Act.4.29|Act.4:29]]†
(AS)

G1821.def:
**ἐξ-απο-στέλλω **
[in LXX freq., chiefly for שָׁלַח pi. ;]
1. **to send forth**: with accusative of person(s), [[Act.7.12; 12.11|Act.7:12 12:11]], [[Gal.4.4|Gal.4:4]]; τ. ἐπαγγελίαν, [[Luk.24.49|Luk.24:49]] τ. πνεῦμα, [[Gal.4.6|Gal.4:6]] [τ. κήρυγμα, [[Mrk.16.1-20|Mrk.16:1-20]], "shorter conclusion," WH ;] before εἰς, [[Act.22.21|Act.22:21]] pass., ὁ λόγος, [[Act.13.26|Act.13:26]]
2. **to send away**: with accusative of person(s), before εἰς, [[Act.9.30|Act.9:30]] before ἕως, [[Act.11.22|Act.11:22]] with inf., [[Act.17.14|Act.17:14]] κενόν, [[Luk.1.53; 20.10-11|Luk.1:53 20:10-11]].†
(AS)

G1836.def:
**ἑξῆς **
_adv._ (ἔχω),
**in order, successively, next**: τῇ ἑ. ἡμέρᾳ, [[Luk.9.37|Luk.9:37]] ἐν τῷ ἑ. (sc. χρόνῳ), soon after, [[Luk.7.11|Luk.7:11]] τῇ ἑ. (sc. ἡμέρα), [[Act.21.1|Act.21:1]] [[Act.25.17|Act.25:17]] [[Act.27.18|Act.27:18]].†
(AS)

G1823.def:
**ἐξ-αστράπτω **
[in LXX: [[Num.3.3|Num.3:3]] (בָּרָק), [[Ezk.1.4|Eze.1:4]] (לָקַח hithp.) 17 Dan LXX 106 (קָלַל)* ;]
**to flash like lightning, gleam, be radiant**: ἱματισμός, [[Luk.9.29|Luk.9:29]]†
(AS)

G1841.def:
**ἔξ-οδος**, -ου, ὁ
(ὁδός), [in LXX chiefly for מוֹצָא also חוּץ, etc. ;]
**a going out, departure**: [[Heb.11.22|Heb.11:22]] of death, [[Luk.9.31|Luk.9:31]], [[2Pe.1.15|2Pe.1:15]].†
(AS)

G1879.def:
**ἐπ-ανα-παύω **
[in LXX, mid., for נוּחַ, שָׁעַן ni ;]
**to refresh, cause to rest **(upon); mid., **to rest upon**: metaphorically, with dative, [[Rom.2.17|Rom.2:17]] before ἐπί, with accusative, [[Luk.10.6|Luk.10:6]] (Cremer, 827).†
(AS)

G1871.def:
**ἐπ-αιτέω**, -ῶ, [in LXX: Psa_109:10 (H7592) Sir_40:28 * ;]
1. to ask besides.
2. **to beg **(as a mendicant; cf. MM, _Exp._, xiv): [[Luk.16.3; 18.35|Luk.16:3 18:35]] (Cremer, 74).†
(AS)

G1867.def:
**ἐπ-αινέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for הָלַל pi., שָׁבַח pi. ;]
**to praise**: with accusative, [[Rom.15.11|Rom.15:11]], [[1Co.11.22|1Co.11:22]]; before ὅτι, [[Luk.16.8|Luk.16:8]], [[1Co.11.2|1Co.11:2]]; absol., before ὅτι, [[1Co.11.17|1Co.11:17]]†
(AS)

G1848.def:
**ἐξ-ουθενέω**, -ῶ
(οὐθείς, which see), [in LXX (see: ἐξουθενέω): [[1Sa.2.30|1Ki.2:30]], al., and as seel. for -δενέω, -όω, -θενόω* ;]
**to set at nought, despise utterly, treat with contempt**: with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.18.9; 23.11|Luk.18:9 23:11]], [[Rom.14.3, 10|Rom.14:3, 10]], [[1Co.16.11|1Co.16:11]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[Gal.4.14|Gal.4:14]], [[1Th.5.20|1Th.5:20]]; pass., of persons: [[Mrk.9.12|Mrk.9:12]] (T, -όω), [[1Co.6.4|1Co.6:4]] of things λίθος, [[Act.4.11|Act.4:11]] (LXX ἀπεδοκίμασαν); λόγος, [[2Co.10.10|2Co.10:10]] τὰ ἐξουθενημένα, [[1Co.1.28|1Co.1:28]]†
_SYN._: ἀθετέω, καταφρονέω (see _DCG_, i, 453b) (AS)

G1850.def:
**ἐξουσιάζω**
(ἐξουσία) [in LXX (frequently in Ec) chiefly for שָׁלַט ;]
1. to exercise authority (Arist.).
2. Trans., **to exercise authority over**: with genitive of person(s), [[Luk.22.25|Luk.22:25]] with genitive of thing(s), [[1Co.7.4|1Co.7:4]] pass., **to be held under authority **(see Lft., _Notes_, 214): before ὑπό, [[1Co.6.12|1Co.6:12]]†
(AS)

G1809.def:
**ἐξ-αιτέω**, -ῶ
**to ask from**; mid., **to ask for oneself, demand**: aor., ἐξῃτήσατο, with accusative (obtained you by asking, R, mg.), [[Luk.22.31|Luk.22:31]] (see Field, _Notes_, 76; Cremer, 73).†
(AS)

G1834.def:
**ἐξ-ηγέομαι**, -οῦμαι
[in LXX chiefly for סָפַר pi. ;]
**to lead, show the way**; metaphorically, **to unfold, narrate, declare**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Luk.24.35|Luk.24:35]] [[Act.21.19|Act.21:19]]; with dative of person(s), [[Act.10.8|Act.10:8]] θεόν (understood), [[Jhn.1.18|Jhn.1:18]] before ὅσα, [[Act.15.12|Act.15:12]] καθώς, [[Act.15.14|Act.15:14]]†
(AS)

G1860.def:
**ἐπ-αγγελία**, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπαγγέλλω), [in LXX: [[Psa.56.8|Psa.56:8]] (סֵפֶר), etc. ;]
1. a summons (as Attic law-term, Dem., al.).
2. **a promise **(Dem., Arist., al.): [[Act.23.21|Act.23:21]] esp. in NT of the divine promises, [[Act.7.17|Act.7:17]], [[Rom.4.14, 16|Rom.4:14, 16]] [[Rom.9.4|Rom.9:4]], [[Gal.3.17-18, 21; 4.23|Gal.3:17-18, 21 4:23]], [[Heb.8.6; 11.9, 17|Heb.8:6 11:9, 17]], [[2Pe.3.9|2Pe.3:9]]; with inf., [[Heb.4.1|Heb.4:1]] γίνεται, etc., with dative of person(s), [[Act.2.39|Act.2:39]], [[Rom.4.13|Rom.4:13]], [[Gal.3.16|Gal.3:16]]; before πρός, [[Act.13.32; 26.6|Act.13:32 26:6]]; έπαγγέλεσθαι τὴν ἐ., [[1Jn.2.25|1Jn.2:25]] ἔχειν ἐπαγγελίας, [[Heb.7.6|Heb.7:6]], [[2Co.7.1|2Co.7:1]]; εἷναι νἐ έπαγγελίᾳ, [[Eph.6.2|Eph.6:2]] ἡ γῆ τῆς ἐ., [[Heb.11.9|Heb.11:9]] τὰ τέκνα τῆς ἐ., [[Rom.9.8|Rom.9:8]], [[Gal.4.28|Gal.4:28]]; τ. πνεῦμα τῆς ἐ. τ. ἅγιον, [[Eph.1.13|Eph.1:13]] αἱ διαθῆκαι τῆς ἐ., [[Eph.2.12|Eph.2:12]] ἡ ἐ. τ. θεοῦ, [[Rom.4.20|Rom.4:20]] pl., [[2Co.1.20|2Co.1:20]] αἱ ἐ. τ. πατέρων, [[Rom.15.8|Rom.15:8]] with genitive obj., τ. ζωῆς (see Dalman, _Words_, 103), [[1Ti.4.8|1Ti.4:8]] τ. παρουσίας αὐτοῦ, [[2Pe.3.4|2Pe.3:4]] κατ ̓ ἐπαγγελίαν, [[Act.13.23|Act.13:23]], [[Gal.3.29|Gal.3:29]], [[2Ti.1.1|2Ti.1:1]]; δι ̓ ἐπαγγελίας, [[Gal.3.18|Gal.3:18]] συμμέτοχα τῆς ἐ., [[Eph.3.6|Eph.3:6]] λόγος ἐπαγγελίας, [[Rom.9.9|Rom.9:9]] By meton. (cf. ἐλπίς), of a promised blessing: [[Luk.24.49|Luk.24:49]], [[Act.1.14|Act.1:14]], [[Gal.3.22|Gal.3:22]], [[Heb.6.12-17; 10.36; 11.13, 33; 11.39|Heb.6:12-17 10:36 11:13, 33 11:39]]; with genitive epexeg., [[Act.2.33|Act.2:33]] [[Gal.3.14|Gal.3:14]], [[Heb.9.15|Heb.9:15]] (Cremer, 27).†
(AS)

G1852.def:
**ἐξ-υπνίζω **
[in LXX: [[Jdg.16.14, 20|Jdg.16:14, 20]], [[1Ki.3.13|3Ki.3:13]] (יָקַץ), [[Job.14.12|Job.14:12]] (עוּר ni.)* ;]
**to awaken out of sleep **(= ἀφυπνίζω): with accusative of person(s), [[Jhn.11.11|Jhn.11:11]]†
(AS)

G1886.def:
**ἔπ-αυλις**, -εως, ἡ
(αὐλή), [in LXX for חָצֵר, טִירָה, (l.with), etc. ;]
**a dwelling, habitation**: [[Act.1.20|Act.1:20]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G1801.def:
**ἐνωτίζομαι**
(οὖς),
depon. mid.,
[in LXX chiefly for אָזַן hi. ;]
**to give ear to, hearken to**: with accusative, [[Act.2.14|Act.2:14]]†
Also used for יָחַל שָׁמַע
(AS)

G1814.def:
**ἐξ-άλλομαι **
[in LXX for קָלַל ([[Hab.1.8|Hab.1:8]]), etc. ;]
**to leap up**: [[Act.3.8|Act.3:8]]†
(AS)

G1813.def:
**ἐξ-αλείφω **
[in LXX for טוּחַ, [[Lev.14.42|Lev.14:42]], al.; metaphorically, מָחָה, שָׁחַת, etc. ;]
1. to plaster, wash over (LXX).
2. **to wipe off, wipe out**: δάκρυον, [[Rev.7.17; 21.4|Rev.7:17 21:4]]; metaphorically, χειρόγραφον, [[Col.2.14|Col.2:14]] τ. ὄνομα, before ἐκ, [[Rev.3.5|Rev.3:5]] (MM, _Exp._, xiii); pass., ἀμαρτίαι (ἐξαλιφθῆναι, WH), [[Act.3.19|Act.3:19]] (cf. [[Psa.51.11|Psa.51:11]] [[Psa.109.13|Psa.109:13]], [[Isa.43.25|Isa.43:25]], [[Sir.46.20|Sir.46:20]] (ἁμ. ἀπαλ-), [[3Ma.2.19|3Ma.2:19]]).†
(AS)

G1842.def:
**έξ-ολεθρεύω**
(so best MSS. and WH; also read -οθρεύω), [in LXX frequently (rare in Gk. writers) for כָּרַת ni., hi., etc. ;]
**to destroy utterly**: before ἐκ τ. λαοῦ, [[Act.3.23|Act.3:23]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G1863.def:
**ἐπ-άγω **
[in LXX for בּוֹא hi., etc. (29 words in all) ;]
**to bring upon**: with dative and accusative, [[2Pe.2.5|2Pe.2:5]] ἑαυτοῖς ἐ. (for cl. mid., see Mayor, in l), [[2Pe.2.1|2Pe.2:1]] ἐ. τὸ αἷμα (cf. Ge 209), [[Act.5.28|Act.5:28]]†
(AS)

G1856.def:
**ἐξ-ωθέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for נָדָה hi. ;]
1. **to thrust out**: [[Act.7.45|Act.7:45]]
2. **to drive out of the sea, drive on shore**: [[Act.27.39|Act.27:39]] (WH, txt., ἐκσῶσαι).†
*ἐκ-σώζω,
**to preserve from danger, bring safe**: [[Act.27.39|Act.27:39]] (ἐξῶσαι, WH, mg., R, txt., see: ἐξωθέω).†
**ἐξ-ωθέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for נָדָה hi. ;]
1. **to thrust out**: [[Act.7.45|Act.7:45]]
2. **to drive out of the sea, drive on shore**: [[Act.27.39|Act.27:39]] (WH, txt., ἐκσῶσαι).†
*ἐκ-σώζω,
**to preserve from danger, bring safe**: [[Act.27.39|Act.27:39]] (ἐξῶσαι, WH, mg., R, txt., see: ἐξωθέω).†
(AS)

G1826.def:
**ἔξ-ειμι**
(εἶμι),
**to go forth**: [[Act.13.42|Act.13:42]] [[Act.17.15|Act.17:15]] [[Act.20.7|Act.20:7]]; before ἐπί, with accusative, [[Act.27.43|Act.27:43]]†
(AS)

G1892.def:
**ἐπ-εγείρω **
[in LXX for עוּר hi., קוּם hi., etc. ;]
**to rouse up, excite**: C. accusative of thing(s), διωγμόν, [[Act.13.50|Act.13:50]] ψυχάς, [[Act.14.2|Act.14:2]]†
(AS)

G1876.def:
**ἐπανάγκης**, -ες
(ἀνάγκη), only in neut.;
1. ἐπάναγκες (sc. ἐστί), it is compulsory, necessary.
2. As adv., of necessity: [[Act.15.28|Act.15:28]]†
(AS)

G1845.def:
**ἐξ-ορκιστής**, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἐξορκίζω),
1. one who administers an oath.
2. **an exorcist**: [[Act.19.13|Act.19:13]]†
(AS)

G1822.def:
**ἐξ-αρτίζω**
(ἄρτιος), [in LXX. [[Exo.28.7|Exo.28:7]] (חָבַר pu.) * ;]
1. **to com­plete, finish**: τ. ἡμέρας, [[Act.21.5|Act.21:5]]
2. **to furnish, supply**: pass., [[2Ti.3.17|2Ti.3:17]] (for exx., see MM, _Exp._, xiii; Cremer, 651).†
(AS)

G1885.def:
**ἐπαρχεία** (Rec. -χία, see Bl., § 3, 5), -ας, ἡ
(ἔπαρχος, a prefect), [in LXX: [[Est.4.11|Est.4:11]] (מְדִינָה), [[Jdt.3.6|Jdth.3:6]] A* ;]
**the jurisdiction of a prefect, a province**: [[Act.23.3, 34; 25.1|Act.23:3, 34 25:1]].†
*†ἐπάρχεισς, -ον,
**of a prefect**: ἡ ἐ. (sc. ἐξουσία) = ἐπαρχεια, which see, [[Act.25.1|Act.25:1]] (WH, mg.).†
(AS)

G1851.def:
**ἐξοχή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐξέχω, to stand out), [in LXX for שֵׁן, [[Job.39.28|Job.39:28]] * ;]
1. a projection (ἐ. πέτρας, [[Job.39.28|Job.39:28]]).
2. Metaphorical, **eminence, excellence**: οἱ κατ᾽ ἐ., the chief men, [[Act.25.23|Act.25:23]]†
(AS)

G1818.def:
**ἐξ -απατάω**, -ῶ strengthened form of ἀπατάω,
[in LXX: [[Exo.8.29|Exo.8:29]] (הָתַל hi.), Da TH [[Sus.5.6|Sus 5:6]]* ;]
**to deceive**: with accusative, [[Rom.7.11|Rom.7:11]] [[Rom.16.18|Rom.16:18]], [[1Co.3.18|1Co.3:18]], [[2Co.11.3|2Co.11:3]], [[2Th.2.3|2Th.2:3]]; pass., [[1Ti.2.14|1Ti.2:14]]†
(AS)

G1825.def:
**ἐξ-εγείρω **
[in LXX for עוּר ni., hi., etc. ;]
**to raise up**: [[Rom.9.17|Rom.9:17]] (cf. _ICC_, in l); from the dead, [[1Co.6.14|1Co.6:14]]†
(AS)

G1878.def:
**ἐπ-ανα-μιμνήσκω **
**to remind again**: with accusative of person(s), [[Rom.15.15|Rom.15:15]]†
(AS)

G1808.def:
**ἐξ-αίρω **
[in LXX for נָסַע, יָרַשׁ hi., כָּרַת ni., מוּת, בָּעַר pi., etc. ;]
**to lift up, lift off the earth, remove**: [[1Co.5.13|1Co.5:13]] (LXX)†
(AS)

G1820.def:
**ἐξ-απορέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX, pass., for פּוּן, [[Psa.88.15|Psa.88:15]] * ;]
so in NT, depon. pass., **to be utterly at a loss, be in despair**: absol. (as Ps, l.with), [[2Co.4.8|2Co.4:8]] τοῦ ζῆν, [[2Co.1.8|2Co.1:8]]†
(AS)

G1873.def:
**ἐπ-ακούω **
[in LXX for שָׁמַע, עָנָה, etc. ;]
1. to listen to.
2. **to hearken to, hear with favour **(one's prayer): with genitive of person(s), [[2Co.6.2|2Co.6:2]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G1805.def:
**ἐξ-αγοράζω **
[in LXX: καιρόν ὑμεῖς ἐξαγοράζετε (זְבַן), Dan LXX TH [[Dan.2.8|Dan.2:8]] * ;]
1. **to redeem, ransom **(esp. of slaves): metaphorically, [[Gal.3.13; 4.5|Gal.3:13 4:5]].
2. **to buy up**; mid., **to buy up for oneself**: τ. καιρόν, [[Eph.5.16|Eph.5:16]], [[Col.4.5|Col.4:5]] (Cremer, 60).†
(AS)

G1840.def:
**ἐξ-ισχύω **
[in LXX: [[Sir.7.6|Sir.7:6]] * ;]
**to have strength enough, to be quite able**: with inf., [[Eph.3.18|Eph.3:18]]†
(AS)

G1815.def:
**ἐξ-ανάστασις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἐξανίστημι),
**a rising again**: ἐκ τ. νεκρῶν, [[Php.3.11|Php.3:11]] (Cremer, 308).†
(AS)

G1837.def:
**ἐξ-ηχέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Jol.3.14|Jol.3:14]] (הָמוֹן), [[Sir.40.13|Sir.40:13]], [[3Ma.3.2|3Ma.3:2]] * ;]
**to sound forth **(as a trumpet, or thunder; see M, _Th._, l.with): pass., [[1Th.1.8|1Th.1:8]]†
(AS)

G1884.def:
**ἐπ-αρκέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[1Ma.8.26|1Ma.8:26]] [[1Mac.11.35|1Mac 11:35]] * ;]
1. to be strong enough for.
2. to ward off.
3. **to aid, relieve**: with dative of person(s), [[1Ti.5.10; 5.16|1Ti.5:10 5:16]] (mid., WH, mg.).†
(AS)

G1872.def:
**ἐπ-ακολουθέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX (chiefly metaphorically) for אָחַר, הָלַךְ, etc. ;]
**to follow after**; in NT metaphorically; absol.: [[Mrk.16.20|Mrk.16:20]] (illustrated by use in verifying accounts; see MM, _Exp._, xiv; Milligan; _NTD_, 78); with dative of person(s), of sins, [[1Ti.5.24|1Ti.5:24]] (cf. Ellic. and CGT, in l); τ. ἴχνεσιν, [[1Pe.2.21|1Pe.2:21]] ἔργῳ ἀγαθῷ, [[1Ti.5.10|1Ti.5:10]]†
(AS)

G1882.def:
**ἐπ-αν-όρθωσις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἐπανορθόω, to correct, restore; of. [[2Ma.2.22|2Ma.2:22]]) [in LXX: I [[Est.8.52|Est.8:52]], [[1Ma.14.34|1Ma.14:34]] * ;]
**correction**: of life, [[2Ti.3.16|2Ti.3:16]] (cf. MM, _Exp._, xiv).†
(AS)

G1838.def:
**ἐξις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἔχω), [in LXX, cf. Sir, prol.9 ;]
**habit, use, experience**: [[Heb.5.14|Heb.5:14]]†
(AS)

G1898.def:
**ἐπ-εισ-αγωγή**, -ῆς, ἡ
**a bringing in besides or in addition **(Hipp., FlJ, al.): [[Heb.7.19|Heb.7:19]] (cf. MM, _Exp._, xiv).†
(AS)

G1828.def:
**ἐξ-έλκω **
[in LXX: [[Gen.37.28|Gen.37:28]] (מָשַׁךְ), etc. ;]
**to draw out or away**: metaphorically, ὑπὸ τ. ἐπιθυμίας, [[Jas.1.14|Jas.1:14]] (see Mayor, in l).†
(AS)

G1830.def:
**ἐξ-εραυνάω**
(Rec. ἐξερευνάω), -ῶ, [in LXX for חָקַר, נָצַר, etc. ;]
**to search out, search carefully**: before περί, [[1Pe.1.10|1Pe.1:10]]†
(AS)

G1804.def:
**ἐξ-αγγέλλω **
[in LXX chiefly for סָפַר pi. ;]
**to tell out, proclaim**: [[1Pe.2.9|1Pe.2:9]] [[[Mrk.16.1-20|Mrk.16:1-20]], "shorter conclusion"] (Cremer, 29).†
(AS)

G1811.def:
**ἐξ-ακολουθέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX [[Amo.2.4|Amo.2:4]], [[Jer.2.2|Jer.2:2]] (אַחַר הָלַךְ), [[Isa.56.11|Isa.56:11]] (פָּנָה), [[Job.31.9|Job.31:9]] (פָּתָה ni.), [[Sir.5.2|Sir.5:2]], Dan LXX TH [[Dan.3.1-30|Dan.3:1-30]] :(41) * ;]
**to follow, follow up **(in various senses): metaphorically, [[2Pe.1.16; 2.2; 2.15|2Pe.1:16 2:2 2:15]] †
(AS)

G1864.def:
**ἐπ-αγωνίζομαι ** depon.;
1. to contend with (Plut.).
2. **to contend for **(C.I., 2335, 19): with dative of thing(s), [[Jude.3|Ju 3]].†
(AS)
